parallelism.notes: Static HTML edits + policy generator scripts in beyound. Cross-repo work spans supermade (Next.js apps) and mewt-backend-v3 (FastAPI); each repo has its own CI, do not interleave commits across them.

commands.test: (this repo is static HTML — no test command. supermade: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test. mewt-backend-v3: pytest)
commands.build: (static — n/a. supermade per-app: pnpm --filter @pay/wallet build with NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND=beyound)
commands.deploy_beyound: git push origin main (GitHub Pages, served at beyound.in via CNAME)
commands.deploy_supermade: git push origin main (CI builds per-brand Docker images, commits image tags to mewt-app/devops, ArgoCD rolls out)
commands.deploy_backend_prod: git tag v0.1.<next> && git push origin v0.1.<next> (workflow validates tag is from main)
commands.deploy_backend_dev: merge to develop (auto-deploys to dev cluster only — NOT prod)

user_preferences: caveman mode (full) active — drop articles/filler/hedging; fragments OK; code/commits/security in normal English
no emojis in code unless explicitly requested
no stubs/placeholders/TODOs — production-ready or say so
auto-commit after each completed task with real conventional-commit messages (feat/fix/chore/etc.)
stage specific files, not git add -A
About Us + policies live only on beyound.in; bills + wallet link out
wallet OTP via twilio notification-otp wrapper, 6-digit codes
Beyound entity name: BeyoundExtra Tech Private Limited (NOT Technologies)
